name: to-fusion-skill-sets
description: Autonomous Autodesk Fusion 360 parametric CAD engineering skills and rulesets for AI agents (Antigravity, Claude, Cursor)
author: Kamish

3mf-to-fusion.name: 3mf-to-fusion
3mf-to-fusion.description: Advanced CAD reverse-engineering engine for 3MF and STL files. Extracts ground-truth STLs, performs evidence-first multi-axis sectioning and batched metrology (X/Y/Z section packs, 45° rails, obround slots, guide pins, card bezels), enforces per-part phased feature ledgers, and synthesizes 100% native parametric BRep solid bodies in Autodesk Fusion 360 with quantitative slice-diff and translucent ghost verification.

media-to-fusion.name: media-to-fusion
media-to-fusion.description: Converts images, multi-angle photo sets, technical drawings, or videos of mechanical/physical objects into functional, parametric 3D CAD models and assemblies in Fusion 360 via computer vision metrology, kinematic synthesis, and the Fusion 360 MCP server.

text-to-fusion.name: text-to-fusion
text-to-fusion.description: Translates natural language descriptions, mechanical adjustments, fastener BOM requests, exploded assembly diagrams, and kinematic animations into 100% native, parametric 3D CAD models and assemblies in Autodesk Fusion 360 via the Fusion 360 MCP server.
